name: docker-lab
description: Docker as a lab for your agent: it runs and tries software (tools, services, someone's code) in isolated containers without touching your computer, verifies that things work by running them, and manages your Docker, through docker-mcp, in the mode you choose (only read, only labs, or everything).

interface.shortDescription: Your AI agent runs and tries software in Docker labs, without touching your computer.
interface.longDescription: Docker as a lab for your agent: it runs and tries software (tools, services, someone's code) in isolated containers without touching your computer, verifies that things work by running them, and manages your Docker, through docker-mcp, in the mode you choose (only read, only labs, or everything).
